<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D443 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mfrac space="4"><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c63"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c63"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c20"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c70"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c64"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c69"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c63"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c69"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6E"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c73"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c61"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6C"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c20"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c70"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c64"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c69"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c63"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c69"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6E"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c73"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">Suppose test accuracy = 87%.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Step 3: Define Experience (E)</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">Training data of 10,000 customers with past purchase labels.</p>
<p dir="auto">Thus the problem is well-posed:</p>
<blockquote dir="auto">
<p>The system improves at predicting purchases (T),<br>
measured by accuracy (P),<br>
based on 10,000 labeled examples (E).</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Final Summary</strong>
</h2>
<p dir="auto">Machine learning begins with clarity:<br>
Every problem must specify what we want to learn, how we measure success, and what experience is available.</p>
<p dir="auto">Then we choose:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">representations,<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">hypothesis spaces,<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">and learning algorithms<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">— all guided by perspectives from statistics, optimization, and pattern recognition.</p>
<p dir="auto">Throughout, challenges such as overfitting, noise, high dimensions, and poor evaluation threaten the quality of learning.</p>
<p dir="auto">Understanding these foundations gives us the lens through which all future machine learning algorithms make sense.</p>
<hr>
<hr>
<h2 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Regression</strong>
</h2>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Regression: The Search for a Predictive Law</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">When we collect pairs of numbers — like hours studied and marks scored, engine size and fuel consumption, or room area and rent — we sense that one quantity influences the other.</p>
<p dir="auto">If we put these pairs on a graph as points, we usually see some inclination: the cloud of points drifts upward or downward. Amid all the randomness, there is direction.</p>
<p dir="auto">The natural question is:</p>
<p dir="auto">“Can we write a rule that captures this relationship and lets us predict new values?”</p>
<p dir="auto">Regression is the study of such rules for numeric prediction.</p>
<p dir="auto">The simplest rule we can imagine is a straight line. It may not capture every twist of reality, but it often captures the broad trend. A line is easy to understand, to compute, and to explain.</p>
<p dir="auto">So we start with:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="4"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c30"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2B"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">Two numbers — the intercept and the slope — become our knobs for fitting the data.</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Why Use a Line?</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">A line is the simplest nontrivial function. It does not bend, oscillate, or surprise us. It tells a clear story:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">When (x = 0), the output is (\theta_0).<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">For each unit increase in (x), the output changes by (\theta_1).<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Many real-world relationships, when not pushed to extremes, behave almost linearly: double the input, roughly double the effect. Even when the relationship is not exactly linear, a line still offers a good first approximation.</p>
<p dir="auto">This simplicity is powerful:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">It avoids overreacting to noise.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">It is easy to fit and analyze.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">It serves as a foundation for more complex models.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">The Best-Fit Line: Making “Best” Precise</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">Imagine standing in front of a scatter plot with a transparent ruler. You slide and tilt it until the line seems to pass “through the middle” of the points. Your eyes are trying to minimize the overall discrepancy.</p>
<p dir="auto">For a data point <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="2"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>, the line predicts <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>. The vertical difference is:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-msub><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">If we simply summed these errors, positive and negative ones might cancel out. Instead, we square them:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c54"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c74"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c61"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6C"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c20"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c73"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c71"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c75"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c61"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c64"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c20"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-munderover space="4"><mjx-over style="padding-bottom: 0.192em; padding-left: 0.412em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-texatom></mjx-over><mjx-box><mjx-munder><mjx-row><mjx-base><mjx-mo class="mjx-lop"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2211 TEX-S2"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-base></mjx-row><mjx-row><mjx-under style="padding-top: 0.167em; padding-left: 0.148em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-texatom></mjx-under></mjx-row></mjx-munder></mjx-box></mjx-munderover><mjx-msup space="2"><mjx-mrow><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-mrow><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.477em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msup></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">The best-fit line is the line for which this total squared error is as small as possible.</p>
<p dir="auto">Formally, we choose (\theta_0, \theta_1) to minimize:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D43D TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c30"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="2"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mfrac><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-mrow></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac><mjx-munderover space="2"><mjx-over style="padding-bottom: 0.192em; padding-left: 0.412em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-texatom></mjx-over><mjx-box><mjx-munder><mjx-row><mjx-base><mjx-mo class="mjx-lop"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2211 TEX-S2"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-base></mjx-row><mjx-row><mjx-under style="padding-top: 0.167em; padding-left: 0.148em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-texatom></mjx-under></mjx-row></mjx-munder></mjx-box></mjx-munderover><mjx-msup space="2"><mjx-mrow><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-mrow><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.477em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msup></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">The factor (1/(2m)) is just a convenient scaling; it doesn’t change which line is best.</p>
<p dir="auto"><span src="attachments/Pasted image 20251120145120.png" class="internal-embed media-embed image-embed is-loaded"><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></span></p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">An <em>Example</em> data with <strong>Fitted</strong>  Line.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">How the Computer Finds the Best Line</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">We can think of the total error <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D43D TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-utext variant="normal" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif;">₀</mjx-utext></mjx-mo></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="2"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-utext variant="normal" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif;">₁</mjx-utext></mjx-mo></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> as a landscape over the <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-utext variant="normal" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif;">₀</mjx-utext></mjx-mo></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="2"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-utext variant="normal" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif;">₁</mjx-utext></mjx-mo></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> plane. Each pair of parameters corresponds to one point in this landscape, with height equal to the error.</p>
<p dir="auto">Our goal is to find the lowest point in this landscape.</p>
<p dir="auto">There are two common strategies:</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Direct jump using linear algebra</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">In matrix notation, the solution for the best weights (w) (the vector of <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-utext variant="italic" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif; font-style: italic;">ⱼ</mjx-utext></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>) can be written as:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mover><mjx-over style="padding-bottom: 0.105em; padding-left: 0.441em; margin-bottom: -0.531em;"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" style="width: 0px; margin-left: -0.25em;"><mjx-c class="mjx-c5E"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-over><mjx-base><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D464 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-base></mjx-mover></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.413em; margin-left: 0.051em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D447 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.413em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-texatom></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.413em; margin-left: 0.051em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D447 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">This is the ordinary least squares formula. Here:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto"><span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is the matrix of inputs (with a column of ones for <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-texatom texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-utext variant="normal" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif;">₀</mjx-utext></mjx-mo></mjx-texatom><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>).<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto"><span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is the column vector of outputs.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto"><span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-utext variant="italic" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif; font-style: italic;">ŵ</mjx-utext></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> denotes our best estimate of the parameter vector.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">This formula jumps directly to the bottom of the error landscape, provided the inverse <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.363em; margin-left: 0.051em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D447 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.363em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-texatom></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> exists.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Walking downhill using gradient descent</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">Another strategy is more intuitive: start somewhere in the landscape and keep walking downhill until no further decrease in error is possible.</p>
<p dir="auto">At each step, we update:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3A"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="4"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D6FC TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mfrac><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D715"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D715"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub></mjx-mrow></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D43D TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">for each parameter (θⱼ), with (α) being the learning rate.</p>
<p dir="auto">This process slowly adjusts the line to reduce the total squared error, just as you would gently tilt the ruler until it “looks right.”</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">When a Single Line Isn’t Enough: Locally Weighted Linear Regression</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">Sometimes the relationship is not globally linear. Consider temperature over a day: it rises in the morning, peaks, then falls. One straight line cannot describe this pattern.</p>
<p dir="auto">Locally Weighted Linear Regression (LWLR) addresses this by fitting many local lines instead of one global line.</p>
<p dir="auto">When predicting at a particular point <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">Nearby training points should matter more.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">Far-away points should matter less.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">To express this, each training point <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-utext variant="italic" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif; font-style: italic;">ᵢ</mjx-utext></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="2"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-utext variant="italic" style="font-family: MJXZERO, serif; font-style: italic;">ᵢ</mjx-utext></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is given a weight:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D464 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c78"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c70"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2061"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mrow space="2"><mjx-mo class="mjx-s3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28 TEX-S3"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mfrac><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.363em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msup></mjx-mrow></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn><mjx-msup><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D458 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.289em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msup></mjx-mrow></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac><mjx-mo class="mjx-s3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29 TEX-S3"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-mrow></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">Here, <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D458 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> controls how “local” the model is:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">Large <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D458 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>: many points have significant weight → behavior close to standard linear regression.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">Small <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D458 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>: only very close points influence the fit → model adapts to local bends.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The regression formula is then solved with these weights included, yielding a line that is tailored to the neighborhood of (x). As we move across the input range, the local line changes smoothly, tracing out a curve.</p>
<p dir="auto"><span src="attachments/Pasted image 20251120145251.png" class="internal-embed media-embed image-embed is-loaded"><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></span></p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">Plot showing the original data in the top frame and the weights applied to each piece of data (if we were forecasting the value of x=0.5). The second frame shows that with k=0.5, most of the data is included, whereas the bottom frame shows that if k=0.01, only a few local points will be included in the regression.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">  <span src="attachments/Pasted image 20251120145440.png" class="internal-embed media-embed image-embed is-loaded"><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></span></p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">Plot showing locally weighted linear regression with three smoothing values. The top frame has a smoothing value of k=1.0, the middle frame has k=0.01, and the bottom frame has k=0.003. The top value of k is no better than least squares. The middle value captures some of the underlying data pattern. The bottom frame fits the best-fit line to noise in the data and results in overfitting.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">These figures make it clear how adjusting (k) moves us from a stiff straight line to an over-flexible wiggly curve.</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Shrinking Coefficients (Regularization)</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">When a model has many parameters, or when data is noisy, the fitted line (or surface) can become too aggressive. Coefficients take on large values, and the model starts chasing noise instead of the underlying pattern.</p>
<p dir="auto">To prevent this, we shrink the coefficients by adding a penalty term to the cost function.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Ridge regression (L2 regularization)</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">We modify the cost function:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D43D TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em; margin-left: -0.078em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c72"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c69"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c64"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c67"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c65"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext></mjx-texatom></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mfrac space="4"><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-mrow></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac><mjx-munderover space="2"><mjx-over style="padding-bottom: 0.192em; padding-left: 0.576em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-texatom></mjx-under></mjx-row></mjx-munder><mjx-msubsup space="2"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.247em; margin-left: 0px;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn><mjx-spacer style="margin-top: 0.193em;"></mjx-spacer><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msubsup></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">Here, <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D706 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is a regularization parameter:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">If <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D706 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is 0, there is no shrinkage.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">If <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D706 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> is large, coefficients are heavily penalized and forced to be small.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">This discourages extreme coefficients and produces smoother, more stable models.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Lasso regression (L1 regularization)</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">Another approach penalizes the <strong>absolute value</strong> of coefficients:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D43D TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em; margin-left: -0.078em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mtext class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c6C"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c61"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c73"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c73"></mjx-c><mjx-c class="mjx-c6F"></mjx-c></mjx-mtext></mjx-texatom></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mfrac space="4"><mjx-frac type="d"><mjx-num><mjx-nstrut type="d"></mjx-nstrut><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-num><mjx-dbox><mjx-dtable><mjx-line type="d"></mjx-line><mjx-row><mjx-den><mjx-dstrut type="d"></mjx-dstrut><mjx-mrow><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-mrow></mjx-den></mjx-row></mjx-dtable></mjx-dbox></mjx-frac></mjx-mfrac><mjx-munderover space="2"><mjx-over style="padding-bottom: 0.192em; padding-left: 0.412em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D45A TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-texatom></mjx-over><mjx-box><mjx-munder><mjx-row><mjx-base><mjx-mo class="mjx-lop"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2211 TEX-S2"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-base></mjx-row><mjx-row><mjx-under style="padding-top: 0.167em; padding-left: 0.148em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mn class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-texatom></mjx-under></mjx-row></mjx-munder></mjx-box></mjx-munderover><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2212"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D456 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-script style="vertical-align: 0.413em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c32"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msup><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2B"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D706 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-munder space="2"><mjx-row><mjx-base><mjx-mo class="mjx-lop"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2211 TEX-S2"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-base></mjx-row><mjx-row><mjx-under style="padding-top: 0.167em; padding-left: 0.576em;"><mjx-texatom size="s" texclass="ORD"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-texatom></mjx-under></mjx-row></mjx-munder><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="2"><mjx-c class="mjx-c7C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D457 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c7C"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">This not only shrinks coefficients but can drive some of them exactly to zero, effectively removing those features from the model.</p>
<p dir="auto">A simple way to think of regularization:</p>
<blockquote dir="auto">
<p>“We allow the model to fit the data, but we charge a small price every time a coefficient grows too large.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">The model chooses the best compromise between fit quality and coefficient size.</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Bias and Variance: The Underlying Balance</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">Every model faces a tension between two types of errors.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Bias</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">Bias is the error due to overly simple assumptions.</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">A straight line trying to fit a strongly curved relationship has high bias.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">It systematically misses important structure.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">No matter how much data we collect, the line remains fundamentally mis-specified.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Variance</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">Variance is the error due to sensitivity to fluctuations in the training data.</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">A highly flexible model can twist and bend to pass through almost every point.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">It fits not only the true pattern, but also random noise.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">A small change in the training set can lead to a very different fitted curve.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">A good model balances both:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">Too simple → high bias, low variance.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">Too complex → low bias, high variance.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">Just right → moderate bias and moderate variance, leading to the lowest total error on unseen data.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Regularization and choices like the LWLR smoothing parameter (k) are tools to navigate this balance.</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">The Story So Far</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">Regression begins with one simple idea: the world often has approximate linear trends. A straight line provides a clear and practical summary of these trends.</p>
<p dir="auto">From there, the story unfolds:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">We make “best” precise by minimizing squared error.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">We have closed-form and iterative ways to find the best line.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">When the world is too curved for one line, we allow many local lines (LWLR).<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">When the model becomes too clever for its own good, we impose discipline through regularization.<br>
</li>
<li dir="auto">Throughout, we are guided by the tradeoff between bias and variance.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">With these tools, regression becomes more than just a line on a graph; it becomes a disciplined way of building numeric prediction models that generalize beyond the data we see.</p>
<hr>
<h3 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Worked Numerical Example – Simple Best-Fit Line</strong>
</h3>
<p dir="auto">Let us see a very small numerical example to make the idea concrete.</p>
<p dir="auto">Suppose we have three data points:</p>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">((1, 2))</li>
<li dir="auto">((2, 3))</li>
<li dir="auto">((3, 5))</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Think of <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> as hours studied and <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> as marks.</p>
<p dir="auto">We assume a line:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c210E TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="4"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c30"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="3"><mjx-c class="mjx-c2B"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub space="3"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D465 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-math></mjx-container></div>
<p dir="auto">Our goal is to find <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c30"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> and <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c28"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-msub><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D703 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-script style="vertical-align: -0.15em;"><mjx-mn class="mjx-n" size="s"><mjx-c class="mjx-c31"></mjx-c></mjx-mn></mjx-script></mjx-msub><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-c class="mjx-c29"></mjx-c></mjx-mo></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> that best fit these points in the least-squares sense.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Write down the normal equation form</strong>
</h4>
<p dir="auto">We construct the matrix <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-math></mjx-container></span> and vector <span class="math math-inline is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML"><mjx-math class="MJX-TEX"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D466 TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi></mjx-math></mjx-container></span>:</p>
<div class="math math-block is-loaded"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="CHTML" display="true"><mjx-math display="true" class="MJX-TEX" style="margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px;"><mjx-mi class="mjx-i"><mjx-c class="mjx-c1D44B TEX-I"></mjx-c></mjx-mi><mjx-mo class="mjx-n" space="4"><mjx-c class="mjx-c3D"></mjx-c></mjx-mo><mjx-mrow space="4"><mjx-mo class="mjx-n"><mjx-stretchy-v class="mjx-c5B" style="height: 3.8em; <h2 style="text-align: left; color: blue;" class="page-header" dir="auto">
  <strong style="color: #cc33cc;">Logistic Regression</strong>
